items.title: Tom Baker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: All right, Jon Faddis, and gee, who else — Benny Goodman, Zoot Sims.

ctx.x: All right, Jon Faddis, and gee, who else — Benny Goodman, Zoot Sims. There was one promoter that brought packages out. And just before I’d gotten there there was another package. It was New Orleans versus bebop, in one of those jazz war things, where they brought the Thelonious Monk band and Monk was so out of it he kind of didn’t play for a few weeks, and George Lewis’ band as well. And they toured together. And they’d appear on the same stage. So you’d get people from both camps coming along and sitting in…
